name: skyfrom
title: SkyFrom
description: Explore the sky over any supported city, copy gradients, and sync your desktop wallpaper.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: explore-sky
commands.title: Explore Sky
commands.description: Search cities and preview their sky gradients.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: current-sky
commands.title: Current Sky
commands.description: Preview the sky for your default location.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: copy-gradient
commands.title: Copy Sky Gradient
commands.description: Copy a gradient in your preferred format.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: set-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Sky Wallpaper
commands.description: Apply a sky gradient as your desktop wallpaper.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: auto-update-wallpaper
commands.title: Auto Update Wallpaper
commands.description: Refresh your sky wallpaper now and periodically when enabled.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: favorite-skies
commands.title: Favorite Skies
commands.description: Browse and reuse saved locations and times.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

commands.name: sky-menu-bar
commands.title: Sky Menu Bar
commands.description: See your last refreshed sky and access wallpaper controls.
commands.subtitle: SkyFrom

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: defaultCity
preferences.title: Default City
preferences.description: Enter a city name or SkyFrom city slug. You can also set a default in Explore Sky.

preferences.name: exportFormat
preferences.title: Export Format
preferences.description: Format used by Copy Sky Gradient and the copy shortcut.

preferences.name: autoWallpaper
preferences.title: Automatic Wallpaper
preferences.label: Update wallpaper in the background
preferences.description: Allow wallpaper updates while Raycast is running.

preferences.name: updateFrequency
preferences.title: Update Frequency
preferences.description: Minimum time between automatic wallpaper updates.

preferences.name: autoCity
preferences.title: Automatic Wallpaper City
preferences.description: Leave empty to use your default city.

preferences.name: saveImages
preferences.title: Save Downloaded Images
preferences.label: Keep a copy of each manually applied wallpaper
preferences.description: Save a copy in the wallpaper directory or Downloads.

preferences.name: wallpaperDirectory
preferences.title: Wallpaper Directory
preferences.description: Destination for saved copies and PNG exports. Defaults to Downloads. Active wallpapers are managed by SkyFrom.
